Commentary.Commentary: Kulasekara, Lakmal and Pradeep picked up two wickets each while Pathirana picked up one. Gunaratne was impressive with his variations and finished with three wickets. Zimbabwe will feel better with this total after their early jitters but it might not be enough for them. Join us back in a bit for the run chase.

Peter Moor kept fighting though as he along with Cremer shared a 55-run stand and that did some damage control for the hosts. Moor missed out on a deserving fifty and the lower order somehow took Zimbabwe past the 150-run mark.

Zimbabwe's fight comes to an end as they're bowled out for a cheap total. They got off to a poor start as their top order crumbled against the Lankan pacers in good conditions for the seamers. Chibhabha was looking good but even he couldn't make his presence felt. Sri Lanka kept chipping in with wickets at regular intervals and the hosts were reduced to 50 for 6.

OUT! That's it! It's all over for the hosts. Fuller length ball outside off, Tinashe Panyangara goes for the big booming slog. He gets a thick top edge which balloons towards covers. Shehan Jayasuriya is the man there and takes a comfortable catch. With that, ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 154!
Coming in from around off, on a length, Tinashe stands his ground and keeps it out on the off side.
Back of a length and slower outside off, it's cut away to backward point for a run.
Looped up around the off stump, kept out off the front foot.
WIDE! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The Umpire signals a wide.
SIX! That's a big hit. Panyangara gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it high over the mid-wicket fence for half a dozen.
Gets low to this one and sweeps it away towards backward square leg for two runs.
Pitched around off, Cremer gets a leading edge to short third man as he closes the face a bit too early. One run taken.
From around the wicket, Pathirana floats it up around off, it's pushed to the cover region.
Graeme Cremer dances down the wicket and ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Around off, it's punched away on the off side to end the over.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Fuller on middle and off, Panyangara kneels down and sweeps it through the square leg region to send it all the way.
Fullish in length outside off, Tinashe lunges forward to block.
TINASHE PANYANGARA walks in.

OUT! The decision is overturned. Coming in from around off, on a length, Mumba leans forward to block but is rapped on the back pad. There are loud appeals for an lbw but the umpire is unmoved. The Lankans are convinced they have their man and so, they take the review. Replays show Carl is gone on all counts.
Mumba is caught leg before and is adjudged not out. Sri Lanka decide to take a review against the decision.
Slightly on the shorter side, around off, it's paddled on the leg side for one run.
Fullish in length and around off, kept out off the front foot presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter and flatter outside off, it's run down towards third man for a single.
Darted on middle and off, looks for the sweep but then at the last second, does well to adjust and block.
Full outside off, it's pushed to the covers for a single.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out with a straight blade.
CARL MUMBA is the next batsman in.

OUT! Short, flat and turning in from outside off, Tiripano rocks back and heaves this towards long on. He gets the elevation on it but not the distance. Kulasekara runs in from the deep and takes a well-judged catch. Sri Lanka with another timely wicket.
Short on off, played to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish on off, pulled to square leg.
Fuller length ball around off, blocked off the front foot.

FOUR! Lovely played. Shorter and flatter outside off, Tiripano waits for it, opens the face and runs it down to third man by playing it very late. Gets a boundary to his name and that's a good way to start the over.
Around off, DT with a drive through mid off for a single to end the over.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Tiripano plays the same shot and drives this full ball towards long on for a single.
This time it's driven to long on for a single.
Full around off, driven towards long off for one.
Dropped! Cremer gets low to this one and reverse sweeps it away. It goes off the keeper's gloves who fails to collect it.
Fuller and coming in on middle and leg, it's worked to short mid-wicket to end the over.
On the hips, it's whipped away by Donald Tiripano through to deep square leg for a couple.
Short, flat and turning it from outside off, Cremer cuts it away through to sweeper cover for one.
Cremer works this length ball in front of short mid-wicket. He won't get any run for it, though.
Shorter and around off, it's punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Tiripano gets behind the line and blocks.
GUNARATNE will have a change of ends.
Full on the stumps, Tiripano hits it down to long on for one.
Full around off, flat as well, Donald reverse sweeps it past the diving first slip fielder and towards short third man.
Cremer pushes this fuller ball towards the cover region and a run is taken.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Tiripano drives this towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Slider on the pads, Donald looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
SACHITH PATHIRANA comes back on.
Short and accurate, Cremer goes for the big pull but the ball rises on him too quickly.
Short of a length outside off, Tiripano squeezes it past the diving point fielder for a single.
Length ball around off, mistimes the drive back to the bowler.

So close! Excellent delivery. Excellent length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Donald Tiripano looks to put bat on ball but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge after straightening up a touch.
Pradeep brings out the short one and pounds it in hard, it's ducked and evaded.
Fuller around off, it's played back down the ground.
Plays with the turn and works it to the square leg region.
Full ball on the stumps, it's driven to mid on for no run.
Full ball just around off, it's driven back down the ground. The fielder from mid on comes across to cut it off as the batsmen take a quick single.
WIDE! It's going down, wide signalled.
Graeme Cremer leans into the full ball and eases it through to deep cover for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Straying on the hips, it's worked fine towards short fine leg for one run.
Low full toss on middle and leg, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Bumper from Pradeep, Donald looks to ramp it over the slip cordon but fails to make any connection.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Tight line as it's pitched on a length around off, kept out from within the crease.
Just back of a length and it's outside off, Cremer cuts this away towards point and picks up a single.
Length delivery straightening up after hitting the deck, kept out off the back foot.
PRADEEP is back on.

This was quite faster from Gunaratne. He bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, there's some extra bounce off the deck as the ball goes past the outside edge. Tiripano looks to run it down to third man but fails to get bat on ball.
Turning in from outside off, on a shorter length, it's worked to the leg side off the back foot.
Very full outside off, Donald goes deep inside his crease and blocks it out.
Fullish well outside off, pushed through to sweeper cover for one.
Cremer comes down the track, not quite to the pitch of the ball but still manages to push it towards short cover.
Loopy and overpitched outside off, Tiripano mistimes his shot down towards long on for a single.
Drinks break!
Back of a length ball outside off, Cremer goes for the pull but misses it completely.
Length ball on off, Cremer defends it with soft hands.
Landed around off, defended watchfully by GC.

DROPPED! Tough chance though! Back of a length ball outside off, Cremer flashes at it and gets a thick outside edge. The wide slip fielder dives to his right and only manages to get his fingertips on it. The ball goes to third man and the batsmen take a couple.
Good length ball around off, Cremer tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
JUST SHORT! Fuller length ball on off, Cremer drives it back to the bowler. The ball falls just short of him.
Landed around off, Tiripano tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball on off, Tiripano drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tad short on off, Donald punches it away off his back foot.
Bowled at 84 kph on off, Tiripano defends it into the ground.
Good length ball outside off, angling in, Tiripano tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
ASELA GUNARATNE comes on to bowl.
Short of a length ball on middle, Tiripano pulls it over backward square leg for a single. Wasn't really controlled.
Landed around off, Donald defends it from within his crease.
DONALD TIRIPANO is the next batsman in.

OUT! Gone next ball! Kulasekara traps him leg before wicket. Sri Lanka get the breakthrough as this stand was frustrating them. It's pitched around the off stump channel, Moor tries to play it off his back foot but misses and gets hit on the back pad. There is a big appeal for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Moor departs after his entertaining knock. Zimbabwe slip to 105 for 7. Replays confirm Moor was a goner as the ball would have hit the middle stump.
50-run stand between Moor and Cremer!
SIX! Amazing shot! Short of a length ball on off, Moor picks it early and sends it sailing over the square leg region for another biggie. Good fightback this by Zimbabwe here. 100 up for them!
Angles it on the pads, Cremer fails to put his bat on the ball. It brushes off the pads and goes to the leg side. The batsmen take a quick single.
Length ball on middle, flicked through square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Full on middle and leg, Cremer tucks it towards backward square leg and asks for a run but he's sent back.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On middle and off, Moor defends it off his back foot.
SIX! Way she goes! This is brilliant batting! Just outside off, Moor slog sweeps it over wide long on for a biggie all the way. This has been a fine knock by Moor.
Cremer comes forward and drills it through mid on for a single.
Short ball on middle and off, the batsman lets it go over him.
Shortish outside off, cut away towards point.
Banged in short on off, Moor lets it go through. The umpire signals one short ball for the over.
Landed around off, Moor stays back in his crease and defends yet again.
Fuller length ball around off, Moor defends it from within his crease.
Short of a length ball on middle and off, Moor pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
NUWAN KULASEKARA is back.
Driven through mid off by Moor for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Tad short outside off, Cremer latches onto it as he punches it hard through the point region and gets a boundary. Good over so far for Zimbabwe.
Full on off, GC drives it back to the bowler.
Fullish outside off, Moor drives it through mid off for a run.
SIX! Brilliant shot! Fullish on middle and leg, Moor gets down on his knee and slogs it over square region. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
Beaten! Short of a length ball outside off, Cremer goes after it but misses it completely.
Shortish ball on off, Cremer punches it away off his back foot.
Fuller length ball outside off, Cremer drives it to covers.
Length ball on off, Cremer stays back in his crease and defends.
Landed outside off, Cremer defends it from within his crease.
FOUR! Edged! Back of a length ball outside off, Cremer tries to push but gets an outside edge which goes over the vacant third slip region for a boundary.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
Tad short on off, punched through mid off for a run.
Full on the pads, Moor tucks it through square leg for a single.
Fullish on middle and leg, Cremer drives it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Cremer defends it solidly.
Fullish on middle and off, Cremer pushes it back to the bowler.
SHEHAN JAYASURIYA to bowl.
Good length ball outside off, PJ Moor defends it with soft hands.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length ball outside off, Moor stays back in his crease and defends.
Good length ball around off, Moor defends it from within his crease.
Length ball on off, Cremer taps it to the off side and takes a quick single. The fielder goes for a direct hit but misses his shy.
Landed outside off, pushed through cover-point for a single.
SURANGA LAKMAL back on.
Tossed up outside off, Cremer drives it to covers.
Flatter on off, Moor punches it to long on for a single.
Landed outside off, Moor pushes it to covers.
Fullish outside off, Cremer comes forward and drives it to long off for a single.
Full on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and on the pads, Moor looks to hit it across but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On a length and pitched outside off, Graeme Cremer leans forward and drives it through the covers for a double.
Back of a length outside off, Peter steers it towards backward point and a single is taken.
Poor line and that's been put away. Much needed boundary for Zimbabwe. It's shaping in on the hips, Moor just glances this down to the fine leg fence and picks up a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, PJ Moor stands firm and firmly punches this away. Unfortunately for him, it's straight to the cover fielder.
WIDE! It's on the shorter side and going down leg, wide signalled by the umpire.
Pradeep unleashes the short one, it's sharp, fast and accurate as Moor is in no position to play this. Awkward tries pulling it away but misses.

That almost took the edge. So close. Short of a length delivery outside off, shaping away a shade, Moor looks to run it down to third man with an angled bat. The ball just climbs on him a little too much and it whiskers past the outside edge.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out. Tightly done by the Zimbabwean skipper.
Peter eases this full ball down to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Moor rocks back and punches it through to deep point. Runs hard and hence is able to come back for the second.
Peter Moor once again presents a solid front foot defensive shot to keep it out.
Full on middle and leg, it's worked to mid-wicket again.
Drifting in with the angle, it's worked off the inner half in front of mid-wicket.
Just back of a length once more, defended solidly to end the over.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, it's played back in the direction of the bowler.
WIDE! Think that was an attempted yorker for Nuwan Pradeep. He is horribly off the mark as he sprays a high full toss down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Once again Pradeep bowls this on a length and it's outside the off stump, Cremer is very watchful as he leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
GRAEME CREMER walks in next.

OUT! PRADEEP WITH ANOTHER BREAKTHROUGH! He's bowling excellently here and getting his just rewards. Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, moving just a touch and that too very late, this does Elton in. He tries to meet it with a straight bat but the ball takes the outside edge and flies into Dickwella's gloves who takes a regulation catch.
Darted outside off, on a full length, Peter with a hard drive straight to the man at covers.
Moor makes better connection this time. Gets it through the gap in the covers and picks up a couple of runs for it.
Peter Moor pushes this full ball to short cover off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This time it's driven to long off for a single.
Fired in on the stumps, it's driven to long on for one.
On a good length and outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chigumbura hangs his bat out to that one but misses. Pat Symcox on air says, "If he's going to play like that he's not going to last for long."
ELTON CHIGUMBURA is the next man in.

OUT! CHIBHABHA IS OUT OF HERE! Looked very close to the naked eye as well. Pradeep angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Chamu Chibhabha walks across to flick it away but misses and is rapped on the pads. There are loud appeals for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Chamu talks with his partner and thinks it might be going down leg. So reviews the decision. It goes upstairs and replays show that the ball was hitting leg. The decision stays and that's another wicket down for the hosts.
Chamu Chibhabha has been caught on the pads and is adjudged out. The opener however isn't convinced and after talking to his partner, decides to take a review against the decision.
Outside off, it's pushed down towards mid off. No run taken.
On a good length and it's a tight line from Nuwan Pradeep, once again it's kept out off the back foot.
Length ball just outside the line of off stump, Moor keeps this one out from deep within the crease.

Drinks break! Zimbabwe are in trouble here. They've lost their key batsmen and it's now up to Peter Moor and Chamu Chibhabha to put on a big partnership. They're going have to dig deep here, especially on a track which is favouring the bowlers at the moment.
Fullish around off, pushed towards extra cover to end the over.
Peter Moor this time defends it from within the crease. It was sliding in with the angle and was negotiated well by the Rhodesian wicketkeeper batsman.
Sliding in around off, Moor does well to bring his bat down to that one and block.
Darts it full on the stumps, it's driven down to long off for one.
Flatter and coming in on middle and leg, goes off the pads as Chamu looks to work it on the leg side.
Sliding down leg, it's worked straight to short fine leg.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Peter Moor taps it on the off side with soft hands but won't get any run for it.
Short and wide outside off, Chamu Chibhabha reaches out to it and slaps it to the deep point fielder.
A change in field here. Sweeper cover has been put in place.
Full and fired in on the stumps, it's pushed to the off side with a straight blade.
WIDE! Banged in short but it's too short, it's signalled as a wide as the batsman ducks under it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chibhabha looks to cut it away but he's a little cramped for room. Fails to make any connection as the ball goes behind to the keeper.
On a good length on middle and off, Chamu Chibhabha stays deep in his crease and keeps it out.

FOUR! Lovely placement. Not much foot movement there but the timing on that was superb. Good length ball outside off, Chibhabha leans ahead a bit and drives it through the gap in the covers. Beats the chasing fielders as the ball races away to the boundary line.
Flatter and sliding in, cut away to the backward point fielder for no run. That'll be the end of the over.
PJ Moor comes forward to this fuller ball and defends it with a straight bat.
On the fuller side this time, no trouble for Chamu to drive it down to long off for a run.
Floats it on a length, on the stumps, it's eased down to long on for a single.
SIX! THAT'S OUT OF HERE! Pathirana tosses it up on middle and off, Peter Moor stands his ground and launches it over the long on boundary for half a dozen. Good shot, that.
Fuller on the stumps, it's kept out off the front foot.
Well wide outside off, Chamu Chibhabha looks to cut it away but fails to make any connection.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Moor plays this towards the point region and takes a single.
Fuller on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket.
Length ball coming in on off stump, Chibhabha closes the face of the bat too early and ends up getting a leading edge towards point. A single is taken.
Pradeep starts off with a back of a length delivery outside off, Chibhabha stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
PJ MOOR is the next man in.

OUT! WILLIAMS IS GONE! The reprieve he got hasn't proved costly for the Lankans. Pathirana darts it on a fuller length, it's flat and sliding away, Williams takes a long hop down the ground in an attempt to go big down the ground but misses it completely. Dickwella behind the stumps collects the ball and takes the bails off easily. Zimbabwe in real trouble now.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and flat around off, it's driven down towards mid off for a brisk single.
Chibhabha defends this off the inner part of the bat towards square leg. The single is on and there is a shy at the striker's end which misses. Risky run taken.
Short and on the stumps, it's punched down to long on for one run.

DROPPED! Off the first ball itself. Short and wide, drifting away from the left-hander, Williams stays back and looks to cut it away but ends up getting an edge. It goes behind to de Silva at first slip who spills it. Should have taken that, really. Dropping someone of Williams' caliber isn't advisable.
SACHITH PATHIRANA comes on to bowl now.
Powwrplay 2 has been signaled. That means 4 fielder will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Landed outside off, Williams pushes it through covers for a single.
Angling in around off, Williams looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Width on offer outside off, Williams punches it to point.
Good length ball outside off, angling in, Williams leaves it alone. The ball was quite close to the off stump.
Landed outside off, Williams defends it watchfully off his back foot.
FOUR! Fuller length ball on the pads, Williams flicks it away through the mid-wicket region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence. Just the second boundary of the innings.
Fullish ball outside off, Chibhabha drives it towards mid on.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, shapes away, Chibhabha tries to defend but misses and the ball whizzes past his outside edge. Terrific bowling by Kulasekara here.
Good length ball around off, Chamu defends it off his back foot.
On the pads, Williams looks to play it across but the ball brushes off the pads and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Fullish and on the pads, flicked to the mid-wicket region.
WIDE! Angles it down the leg side, Williams tries to flick but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Landed outside off, swinging in after landing, Williams doesn't flirt with that one.
Back of a length ball outside off, Williams steers it through backward point for a single.
Good length ball outside off, angling in, Williams stays back in his crease and defends.
Length ball, Chibhabha works it towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Williams tucks it through square leg and takes a single to get off the mark.
Landed around off, Williams defends it from within his crease.
Good length ball landed just outside off, good carry, Williams shoulders his arms.
Short of a length ball, CC tries to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Another play and a miss! Full outside off, this one swings away, Chibhabha goes after it but misses it completely yet again.
BEATEN! Fullish outside off, inswinger, Chibhabha tries to defend but misses it completely. The ball goes through the gap between his bat and pad.
Landed just outside off, Chibhabha defends it into the ground.
Good length ball outside off, jags back in after landing, Chibhabha tries to play it off his back foot but misses and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length ball on off, Chamu flicks it towards mid-wicket, there is a fielder.

CHANCE OF A RUN OUT! Fuller length ball outside off, Chibhabha drives it towards wide mid off and sets off. Bit of a mix up there and there is a throw at the non-striker's end, the fielder misses his shy. Risky run taken.
Back of a length ball on off, CC defends it off his back foot.
On middle and off, Chibhabha flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder dives to stop the ball.
Back of a length ball outside off, Chibhabha mistimes it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery landed just outside off, bit of a movement, Chibhabha shoulders his arms.
Good length ball outside off, Chibhabha pushes it straight to the cover fielder.
Landed outside off, Williams lets it go through yet again.
Fuller length ball outside off, Williams leaves it alone.
In the corridor outside off, Williams shoulders his arms.
Fuller length ball around off, Williams pushes it to the cover region.
SEAN WILLIAMS is in next. He's probably in too early for his liking. Big task ahead of him now to settle things down for his team.

OUT! Raza gone too! Fullish ball on middle and leg, Raza tries to flick it away but plays it straight to the mid-wicket fielder. Sachith Pathirana makes no mistake there and Kulasekara has a wicket as well. Zimbabwe are three down already in the fifth over.
Fuller length ball outside off, Raza presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
Good length ball outside off, Chibhabha shoulders his arms.
Good length ball outside off, angling away, Raza gets a thick outside edge which goes to third man. He is off the mark with a single.
SIKANDAR RAZA is the next batsman in for Zimbabwe. He walks in at No.4.

OUT! ERVINE GONE FOR A DUCK! Good length ball around off, bit of a movement there, Ervine tries to drive it through the off side without any footwork. He pays the price as he gets a thick outside edge which flies straight to de Silva at second slip. Another wicket for Lakmal. Zimbabwe in early trouble here.
Good length ball around off, Ervine defends it with soft hands.
CRAIG ERVINE walks in at No.3.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Good length ball outside off, Chari presses forward to defend but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies almost towards the first slip fielder but Kusal Mendis fielding at second slip goes to his left and takes a good low catch, in front of the first slip fielder. Chari gone and Lakmal gets the early breakthrough for Sri Lanka!
In the corridor outside off, Chari allows it through.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Tad short outside off, Chibhabha cuts it through the point region and beats the fielder there and gets a boundary.
Shortish and on the pads, Chibhabha looks to clip but misses. He is hit on the thigh pad.
Length ball around off, Chibhabha gets onto his front foot and blocks it away.
Angles it on the pads, Chibhabha tries to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
In the air... but safe! On middle and off, Chari slogs it over mid-wicket. No fielder in the deep there and Chari takes three runs.
Good length ball outside off, Chari stays back in his crease and defends.
Good length ball around off, Chibhabha gets onto his front foot and defends it solidly.
Shortish outside off, Chibhabha punches it through covers for a couple. There's a direct hit at the striker's end but the batsman made it.
Landed around off, Chibhabha stays back in his crease and defends.
Good length ball on off, Chibhabha pushes it to the on side and shouts no for a run.
Landed outside off, angling in again, Chari guides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length ball, angling in, Chari defends it from within his crease.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
Fuller length ball outside off, Chibhabha shoulders his arms.
Back of a length ball outside off, Chari steers it through backward point for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Chari drives it through covers and takes a couple to get off the mark.
Landed outside off, Chari gets onto his front foot and defends it to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Chari plays it with soft hands, gets an outside edge towards the slip region.
Good length ball outside off, Chari shoulders his arms.

Right then! The players walk out to the middle. CHAMU CHIBHABHA and BRIAN CHARI are the Zimbabwean openers. NUWAN KULASEKARA to bowl first up for Sri Lanka. Some sightscreen issue here. Upul Tharanga and Kusal Perera go there to see what's the issue. It's sorted now. Here we go!
It is time for the national anthems with the Sri Lankan one first up, followed by the Zimbabwean one.

Zimbabwean captain GRAEME CREMER admits that he wanted to bowl first as well due to the grass on the wicket and the conditions. Agrees that the first hour will be tough but if the batsmen negotiate it, they can put in a good score. Is happy with the return of Chigumbura and Panyangara as it lends experience. Is confident after their good show against India and hopes to repeat the same dose against Sri Lanka as well.

Sri Lankan skipper UPUL THARANGA says that with the intermittent weather around, he always wanted to bowl first. Hopes that his seamers get some movement under the overcast conditions. Feels that most of the players in the ODI squad have played in the Tests, so that is an advantage.
TOSS - Cremer spins the coin and Tharanga calls it correctly. SRI LANKA WILL BOWL FIRST.
WEATHER REPORT - It is already overcast and the threat of rain looms. Hopefully, we get a full game of cricket.

The only worrying sign we have today is that it's quite gloomy out in the middle and there is rain forecast which could play spoilsport. Let's hope it decides to stay away, we have clear skies, well... At least clear enough so that we have a full day of cricketing action.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, will have a lot of rookies playing this time 'round. The team will be led by Upul Tharanga. The side is rather inexperienced but it's a good opportunity for them to stake their claim, giving the selectors something to think about.

Hello and a warm welcome for the opener of the Tri-Nation series between Zimbabwe, Sri Lanka and West Indies. It's taking place in Zimbabwe and first contest will happen at Harare Sports Club between the hosts and the Islanders. These two sides went up against each other in a 2-match Test series very recently and it were the Lankans that came out on top. The Rhodesians did put up a good fight but the 50-over format is a different ball game altogether. Will be interesting to see how they perform.
